message.title: Shoutout message
message.description: What the bot does after a shoutout when no more specific message applies: it announces a message in chat, or it runs one pipeline, action or command instead. A message on a pipeline step and a note you wrote for that person both win over it. Leave the message empty to use the built-in one.
